columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Alias for `fields` — the compiler emits `columns` for field defs.

senderLabelField.label: Sender Label Field
senderLabelField.description: Field holding the sender's human-readable name (used with variant: 'message'). Defaults to `senderField`. Set this when `senderField` holds an id — an id-keyed thread otherwise labels bubbles `staff-1` instead of `Sam Staff`.

accepts.label: Accepts
accepts.description: When set, the container accepts drops whose dragGroup matches this value (or '*' for any group)

emptyMessage.label: Empty Message
emptyMessage.description: Message shown when there are no rows. Falls back to the generic 'no items' translation. `TableView` already exposes this; an agenda or an inbox wants to say what 'empty' means in its own words.

sortBy.label: Sort By
sortBy.description: Field name to order rows by. Values are compared by their own type — numbers numerically, date-like strings chronologically, everything else alphabetically — never by what the field is called. Empty cells sort last. Unset leaves the incoming order untouched. Orders only the rows already fetched: a collection larger than its `limit` still needs ordering at the data layer.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Field definitions for rendering each row. The pattern contract in `@almadar/core/patterns` documents `columns` as the wire-format alias the compiler emits — both names resolve to the same shape here. Pass either.

groupBy.label: Group By
groupBy.description: Group items by a field value (renders section headers between groups)

dragGroup.label: Drag Group
dragGroup.description: When set, items in this container are draggable and announce this group as their source

reorderEvent.label: Reorder Event
reorderEvent.description: Event emitted on reorder: UI:{reorderEvent} with { fromIndex, toIndex }

swipeRightEvent.label: Swipe Right Event
swipeRightEvent.description: Event emitted on right swipe: UI:{swipeRightEvent} with { row }

hasMore.label: Has More
hasMore.description: Whether more items are available for infinite scroll

sortable.label: Sortable
sortable.description: Enable in-container reorder; items can be dragged to new positions among siblings

pageSize.label: Page Size
pageSize.description: Max items to show before 'Show More' button. Defaults to 5. Set to 0 to disable.

look.label: Look
look.description: Layer 2 visual treatment — mirrors the `entity-table` look enum so data-grid / data-list / entity-table share one knob name from authors.

itemClickEvent.label: Item Click Event
itemClickEvent.description: When set, the whole row is clickable and emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row } (action-button clicks stopPropagation so they still win).

maxInlineActions.label: Max Inline Actions
maxInlineActions.description: Max inline action buttons before the rest collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu. Omit = all inline.

positionEvent.label: Position Event
positionEvent.description: Bus event fired N times per drop (one per item in affected zones) so the trait can persist new positions for the WHOLE zone, not just the moved item. Payload: { id, position }

swipeLeftEvent.label: Swipe Left Event
swipeLeftEvent.description: Event emitted on left swipe: UI:{swipeLeftEvent} with { row }

currentUser.label: Current User
currentUser.description: Current user identifier; messages matching this value align right (used with variant: 'message')

dndItemIdField.label: Dnd Item Id Field
dndItemIdField.description: Row field used as the @dnd-kit draggable id (default 'id')

loadMoreEvent.label: Load More Event
loadMoreEvent.description: Event emitted when more items needed: UI:{loadMoreEvent}

dropEvent.label: Drop Event
dropEvent.description: Bus event fired on cross-container drop. Payload: { id, sourceGroup, targetGroup, newIndex }

longPressEvent.label: Long Press Event
longPressEvent.description: Event emitted on long press: UI:{longPressEvent} with { row }

dndRoot.label: Dnd Root
dndRoot.description: Mark this container as the DnD root for its subtree — descendant zones share one DndContext (cross-container drag). Use on an outer container whose own items are not draggable.

senderField.label: Sender Field
senderField.description: Field name identifying the sender (used with variant: 'message')
